notes.title: Old Sparky spotted in Gotchi Guardians!
notes.content: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684698/94731ae215703658f85d29af31e75ad3ee283492.png"][/img][/h1][h1]Old Sparky Update is Live![/h1][p][b][u]What New?[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New Boss - Old Sparky:[/b] a new franken style giant sparky has started to appear in Gotchi Guardians[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Shortcuts & Settings[/b]: New shortcuts have been added to enrich the PC experience with the ability for players to remap[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Tutorial[/b]: Faster, shorter and teaches the game from a different perspective[/p][/*][*][p][b]Balance Changes[/b]: Fun changes to items and licks have been added to make the game feel better[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This update brings more features and balance changes, which you can learn more about in our [url="https://aavegotchi.notion.site/1-2-0-Ol-Sparky-26488105b41280a299a3f9b7bdf4a35a?pvs=73"]Patch Notes[/url][/p]

notes.title: Gotchi Guardians is available now!
notes.content:
[h1]Gotchi Guardians is now available on Steam for everyone! [/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684698/31d470aee6568d7ec1fbae18d6c1c613298ca953.png"][/img][/p][p]It's been a journey for our small indie-sized team to bring the game to this point over the last 2 years, but it's finally here![/p][p][/p][p][u]Are there bugs?[/u][/p][p]sure...[/p][p][/p][p][u]Is the game perfect?[/u][/p][p]no...[/p][p][/p][p][u]Is it fun?[/u][/p][p]hell yes![/p][p][/p][p]With this release, all our core features and systems are fully functional.[/p][p]Are you ready to join us on an adventure as we continue to improve this game into something truly exceptional?[/p][p]Join [url="https://discord.gg/59MXpat9"]our Discord[/url], where we can help you troubleshoot any issues you encounter.[/p][p]Have some feedback? Send it our way, and we will use it to make the game even better.[/p][p]Most importantly, we hope you guys have as much of a blast playing [b]Gotchi Guardians[/b] as we've had making it![/p][p][/p][p]We already have several big updates planned over the coming months for you guys to look forward to.[/p][p][/p][p]The next update will focus on adding more towers and licks to add new challenges and tools for players.[/p][p][/p][p]Here's a concept art of our upcoming tower, the Stohn Nest. Can you guess what it will be?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684698/3d957dafa7185d5cb9eac7d3250d36f57d84aabf.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 is live!
notes.content: [h1]1.0.2 Shaaman Too Good (and moar)[/h1][h1]Overview[/h1][p]This patch focuses on balancing the game and fixing some minor bugs. Hopefully it speeds up the game a bit, improves the difficulty curve, and stops the Shaaman for getting over 700% tower damage buff![/p][p]We also made significant progress in squashing bugs related to earning progression of XP, Badges, and star progression.[/p][p][/p][p]For more details, you can read the [url="https://clear-whale-4dc.notion.site/1-0-2-Shaaman-Too-Good-and-moar-23f88105b4128032a94ce53bcd9b07e0" style="button"]full patch notes[/url][/p]

notes.title: Minor Update 1.0.1
notes.content: [h1]1.0.1 Overview[/h1][p]While this patch focuses on various fixes, it also hopes to address some of our players' more vocal concerns.[/p][p][/p][p]For more details, you can read them [url="https://aavegotchi.notion.site/1-0-1-Release-Patch-23f88105b412803d9973f9599d882587"]here[/url][/p]

[h1]Overview[/h1][p][i]Two years in the making, Gotchi Guardians is leaving Alpha behind![/i][/p][p]With this update, the game is now feature-complete—though we’ll still be squashing bugs. To celebrate this milestone, we’re proud to bring you [b]version 1.0.0[/b], our biggest update yet![/p][p][b]What’s new in 1.0.0[/b][/p][list][*][p]A brand-new map to explore[/p][/*][*][p]Exciting events that shake up the gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Deeper, guardian-specific mechanics and challenges[/p][/*][*][p]Our most significant balance pass to date—gameplay feels smoother than ever[/p][/*][*][p]Launch of the standalone Steam version[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Coming soon[/b][/p][list][*][p]Rapid fire of bug fixes based on your feedback[/p][/*][*][p]A new tower, a lickquidator, and a boss fight[/p][/*][*][p]Even more events[/p][/*][*][p]A new guardian with more items[/p][/*][*][p]…and much more![/p][/*][/list][p]Your support drives everything we do—there’s no shortage of ideas for fun new content![/p][p][/p][p]For more details on all the changes that come with [b]1.0.0 [/b]you can find them here:
[url="https://aavegotchi.notion.site/1-0-0-Release-Patch-23488105b41280e3ae94d416d97aac4f"]https://aavegotchi.notion.site/1-0-0-Release-Patch-23488105b41280e3ae94d416d97aac4f[/url][/p]
